title: How DuckDB's vectorized executor handles late materialization
blurb: A walkthrough of the executor's row-id plumbing with flamegraphs from a TPC-H run, showing where late materialization wins and the two joins where it loses to eager fetching.

title: Sponsored: Ship analytics 10x faster with QueryCloud
blurb: QueryCloud gives your team a managed warehouse in five minutes. Start free, no credit card. Readers of this newsletter get 20% off the first year.

title: The one setting that made our queries 40x faster
blurb: We spent three months chasing a performance problem before discovering a single configuration value was responsible. You will not believe which one.

title: MegaCorp acquires VectorDB Inc for $2.1B
blurb: The acquisition consolidates the vector search market further. Terms were not disclosed beyond the headline figure; the team joins MegaCorp's data division.

title: Reproducing the LSM compaction benchmark on commodity hardware
blurb: Full scripts and raw numbers for re-running the RocksDB compaction comparison on a $400 machine. Our write amplification came out 18% higher than the paper reported; we think we know why.

title: Postmortem: 6 hours of degraded writes from a single missing index
blurb: Timeline, graphs, and the three monitoring gaps that let a sequential scan run for six hours. Includes the query plans before and after, and what the on-call actually saw.

title: We are hiring: Senior Platform Engineer (remote, EU)
blurb: Join a small team building developer infrastructure. Four-day week, generous equipment budget, and no on-call for the first six months.

title: KubeCon EU 2027 call for papers is open
blurb: Submissions close in November. Tracks this year include platform engineering, observability, and a new track on cost efficiency.

title: Why remote work is actually about trust
blurb: An argument that the return-to-office debate has never really been about productivity, drawing on the author's experience running distributed teams for eight years.

title: A query planner that explains its own decisions
blurb: New open-source tool that annotates EXPLAIN output with the cost estimates that drove each choice and flags where the estimate diverged from reality by more than an order of magnitude.

title: io_uring in production: what we measured after a year
blurb: Latency histograms from a year of running io_uring for the write path, the two kernel versions we had to skip, and the fallback path we kept for when it misbehaves.

title: Understanding write amplification
blurb: A gentle introduction to what write amplification is and why it matters for SSD endurance. Aimed at readers new to storage internals.

title: The surprising reason your disk benchmarks lie
blurb: Most published storage benchmarks share a common flaw. We found it after our production numbers refused to match anyone's charts. Read on for what it is.

title: ZFS 3.0 released
blurb: The release adds native encryption improvements, faster resilvering, and a new dedup table format. Full changelog on the project site.

title: Partner content: Benchmark your storage with SpeedLab
blurb: SpeedLab runs a standardized suite against your cluster and produces a comparison report. Free tier available for teams under ten people.

title: Everything announced at the big model launch this week
blurb: Recap of the announcements: longer context, lower pricing, a new agent framework, and an enterprise tier. Every outlet covered this; here is the short version.

title: Series B: DataFlow raises $60M to build the AI data layer
blurb: Led by a tier-one fund with participation from existing investors. The company plans to triple headcount and expand into Europe.

title: Measuring embedding drift in a production retrieval system
blurb: Six months of recall measurements after a model upgrade, the re-indexing strategy that kept the old and new spaces comparable, and the monitoring query that catches drift before users do.

title: Is prompt engineering dead?
blurb: An opinion piece arguing that better models make careful prompting obsolete, with responses from three practitioners who disagree.

title: How we cut our vector index memory by 70%
blurb: Product quantization parameters, the recall we traded away, and the exact memory profile before and after on a 400M-vector index.

title: Postgres 18 is out
blurb: Asynchronous I/O, skip scan, and better partition pruning. The release has been on every front page this week.

title: A tiny tool for diffing query plans
blurb: 200 lines of Python that takes two EXPLAIN ANALYZE outputs and shows which node changed. Written after the author got tired of reading plans side by side in a text editor.
